subsystems.role: runs the tutor locally so it works without a network and keeps student data on the device.

shared memory bus between CPU, GPU and NPU

subsystems.name: Model runtime
subsystems.role: executes a compressed language model fast enough for spoken conversation.

vector index of chunked lesson content

buildSteps.title: Map the curriculum
buildSteps.detail: Subjects are broken into a graph of fine-grained skills, each with prerequisites, mapped to published standards so progress transfers between schools.

buildSteps.title: Curate and index content
buildSteps.detail: Licensed lessons, worked examples and question banks are chunked, embedded and stored in an on-device vector index, with each item tagged to its skill node.

buildSteps.title: Train the tutor behaviour
buildSteps.detail: A base language model is fine-tuned on tutoring transcripts so that it asks leading questions, diagnoses errors and withholds final answers until the student gets there.

buildSteps.title: Compress the model
buildSteps.detail: Weights are quantised, pruned and distilled until the model fits the tablet's memory budget and runs at conversational latency, with quality measured against the uncompressed version.

buildSteps.title: Optimise for the NPU
buildSteps.detail: Operators are rewritten for the chip's accelerators, memory traffic is reduced, and the runtime throttles gracefully rather than overheating the fanless case.

buildSteps.title: Build the learner model
buildSteps.detail: Each answer updates a per-skill mastery estimate; a scheduler brings back weak skills at expanding intervals instead of repeating what is already known.

buildSteps.title: Wire the agent loop
buildSteps.detail: Retrieval, mastery estimation, question selection and dialogue are joined into one loop that can plan a session, react to confusion and stop when the student is tired.

buildSteps.title: Harden privacy and safety
buildSteps.detail: Speech and handwriting are processed on device, cloud calls are opt-in, and filters block age-inappropriate content; the design targets child-data rules such as COPPA, FERPA and GDPR.

buildSteps.title: Validate learning gains
buildSteps.detail: Randomised classroom trials compare progress against ordinary homework and against a teacher-only control, and the curriculum graph is corrected where the model misleads.

prerequisites.tech: Small language models that fit in a tablet
prerequisites.why: models in the low billions of parameters now give useful reasoning at 4-bit precision.

prerequisites.tech: Edge NPUs with enough memory bandwidth
prerequisites.why: accelerators make inference fast, but bandwidth and thermal limits cap model size in a fanless device.
post-training quantisation and distillation cut memory roughly fourfold with modest quality loss.
long-studied statistically and now neural, but predictions are still noisy across subjects.
retrieval is only as good as the mapped content behind it, and rights vary by country.

prerequisites.tech: Evidence that AI tutoring improves learning
prerequisites.why: early trials show gains in narrow settings; results vary with subject, age and how the tool is used.

pathway.milestone: cloud-based AI tutors in pilot classrooms and consumer study apps, plus on-device assistants for narrow tasks such as vocabulary drill
pathway.unlocks: large volumes of interaction data and the first controlled studies.

pathway.milestone: hybrid devices that run a small tutor locally and call the cloud only for hard questions
pathway.unlocks: offline use, low latency and stronger student privacy.

pathway.milestone: a persistent learner model that follows a student across subjects and years with teacher-visible reporting
pathway.unlocks: genuinely continuous personalisation rather than per-session chat.

pathway.milestone: multimodal tutoring that reads handwritten working, spots the exact step where reasoning fails, and links to formal assessment
pathway.unlocks: credible replacement for one-to-one human tutoring in well-structured subjects.
